name: OCaml
description: Code intelligence for OCaml projects using ocamllsp from your opam switch.
about: In Gode’s editor, you can complete code, see errors and warnings, inspect hover information, go to definitions, find references and rename symbols in OCaml files. Install the ocaml-lsp-server package in your opam switch and make ocamllsp available on PATH. This plugin uses the server and compiler from your selected switch. The server starts when you open an OCaml file in a project and stops when none are open.
